heading: String operations — always O(1)
text:
### String operations — always O(1) [LNLS.5.7]

When all `String` slots used in string operations carry `capacity N`
(LNLS.3.10), every string operation in the pump path evaluates in O(1):

| Operation | Bound |
|---|---|
| Single-pattern string ordering `<`/`>` | O(capacity) = O(1) |
| Regex `~`/`!~` | O(capacity × P) = O(1); P fixed in DSC |
| `==`, `!=` on String | O(1) always (interned pointer eq) |
| `len` | O(1) always (stored with intern) |

`capacity` values are compile-time integer literals; they are deployment
constants that appear in T_wcet coefficient calculations the same way
`T_s` (alpha tests per node) does.

The T_wcet formula therefore contains **no O(len) terms** under `linear_scan: false`
when LNLS.3.10 is satisfied.  String operation costs become fixed additive
constants.
